name: University of Latvia
summary: Comprehensive university in Riga; 10 English-taught bachelor's plus Medicine and Dentistry, with some state-funded places open to EU citizens.

handoff.label: English-taught programmes and how to apply

ib.text: No IB-specific page: the Diploma counts as a general secondary diploma. Each degree sets minimum grades on Latvia's 10-point scale; English B2 shows on your certificate or via IELTS 6.0.

lastYear.text: EU/EEA by 16 Aug; state-funded places by 5 July

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Programming, algorithms, databases, web technologies and mathematics, with a 4.5-month internship in an IT organisation after two years and a software-engineering specialisation; carries the Euro-Inf label.

needs.note: Final maths grade of at least 4 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: Fee-paying places only: maths grade 4 of 10 and English B2, then an online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Biotechnology and Bioengineering
programmes.about: A joint English-taught degree of the University of Latvia and Riga Technical University, linking biology, chemistry and engineering with practical work; a route into biotechnology and bioengineering master's study.
programmes.ib: Grades of at least 8 of 10 in Biology and in Maths, Physics or Chemistry, plus an online interview.

needs.note: Biology or Natural Sciences, at least 8 on Latvia's 10-point scale
One of Maths, Physics or Chemistry, at least 8 of 10

programmes.selectionNote: State-funded places ranked on English 20%, Biology 30%, Maths/Physics/Chemistry 30%, average 20%; fee places need 8 of 10 in those subjects. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Prepares you to found and run a business or work in public, private and international organisations, with a specialisation in International Business, plus teamwork, presentation and analytical skills.

needs.note: Final maths grade of at least 4 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: Fee-paying places only: maths grade 4 of 10 and English B2, then an online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Cultural and Social Anthropology
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Social Sciences in Anthropology
programmes.about: Human social and cultural diversity studied through migration, global mobility and intercultural contact, taught by the Faculty of Economics and Social Sciences in English.
programmes.selectionNote: State-funded place ranked on English 60%, Maths 20%, average 20% (+10% for social studies); otherwise a fee place and online interview. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: English, European Languages and Business Studies
programmes.about: Three tracks, English Language, English-Scandinavian Languages, and European Languages and Business Studies, combining English linguistics and culture with a second European language and, in one track, business.
programmes.ib: The state-funded places need proof of Latvian proficiency and a Latvian grade in the ranking; fee-paying places do not.
programmes.selectionNote: Fee places need a passing certificate and English B2, then an online interview; state-funded places are ranked on grades and need Latvian. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: East-West Intercultural Studies
programmes.about: The English-taught strand of the Asian and Intercultural Studies degree: Eastern and Western civilisations compared, with cultural understanding and language learning for work in public bodies, NGOs and business.
programmes.selectionNote: Fee-paying places only: general secondary diploma and English B2, then an online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering and Management
programmes.about: Engineering, management and natural sciences in one interdisciplinary programme leading to the qualification Industrial Management Engineer.

needs.note: Final maths grade of at least 4 on Latvia's 10-point scale
Final physics grade of at least 4 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: Fee-paying places only: grades of 4 of 10 in Maths and Physics and English B2, then an online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Economics and Commercial Diplomacy
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Social Sciences in Economics
programmes.about: International economics and business together with law, politics and foreign languages; builds teamwork and presentation skills and macro- and microeconomic analysis.

needs.note: Final maths grade of at least 4 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: Fee-paying places only: maths grade 4 of 10 and English B2, then an online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Philology (French, German or Russian)
programmes.about: Language, literature and culture studied in English through a French, German or Russian sub-programme, with a second language (Spanish, Italian, Czech or Polish in some strands).
programmes.ib: German Philology requires German proficiency and Russian Philology Russian proficiency; French is only an advantage.
programmes.selectionNote: Fee-paying places only: general secondary diploma and English B2, then an online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Optometry
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Health Sciences in Optometry
programmes.about: Vision science drawn from physics, maths, biology, chemistry and psychology; full qualification as an optometrist needs a master's degree, five years in total.

needs.note: Final maths grade of at least 4 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: Fee-paying places only: maths grade 4 of 10 and English B2, then an online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year English-taught medical degree, 360 ECTS, built on Scandinavian teaching practice with small groups and electives in languages, psychology, economics and law.
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry grades of at least 6 of 10, plus an online interview; fee-paying places only.

needs.note: Biology (or Natural Sciences), at least 6 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on English 20%, Chemistry 40%, Biology 40% (or Natural Sciences 80%); minimum 6 of 10 in Biology and Chemistry; online interview. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.about: Five-year English-taught dentistry degree, 300 ECTS, training you to practise general dentistry independently: diagnosis, treatment planning and restoring tooth shape, function and appearance.
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry grades of at least 6 of 10, plus an online interview; fee-paying places only.

needs.note: Biology (or Natural Sciences), at least 6 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on English 20%, Chemistry 40%, Biology 40% (or Natural Sciences 80%); minimum 6 of 10 in Biology and Chemistry; online interview. 2026 criteria.

notes: EU/EEA citizens can compete for state-funded places on English-taught programmes that offer them (Biotechnology and Bioengineering 8, Anthropology 1); the other degrees are fee-paying for everyone.
Fees are lower for EU/EEA/Swiss citizens than for other nationalities on most programmes; the application fee is 170 euro and must be paid before the deadline.
Business Process Management, Finance Management Information Systems and International Finance are taught at UL FinTech Business School and are listed on that school's page.
